rationale: Identity was properly verified via email lookup, and the agent worked only on the authenticated user’s account. The agent sought and received explicit confirmation before making order and profile changes, used appropriate tools to update both orders’ shipping addresses and the default address, and processed the tablet exchange with the correct refund amount per the tool outputs. However, the agent incorrectly identified the “cheapest tablet” option. Tool data show an available variant at $903.95 (10-inch, 64GB, silver, item 2106335193), which is cheaper than the $941.03 option the agent presented and exchanged. This misinformation led to selecting a not-lowest-cost item, violating the requirement to give correct final information and failing to fulfill the user’s request for the cheapest option.
